name: Asian American Studies

of.text: The Asian American studies concentration of the ethnic studies program is administered by the Center for Asian American Studies. The director and executive committee of this center advises students, prescribes groups of courses that fulfill content requirements, and authorizes course substitutions when appropriate. Students majoring in ethnic studies must meet the requirements as outlined in Ethnic Studies.
